papers.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
papers.review: Frozen all-purpose image/pixel features and smaller distilled encoders are established. Candidate58 uses predicted-box CLS features with a linear TP/FP residual head; it does not reproduce the paper's training or establish a new representation method.

papers.title: Localizing Objects with Self-Supervised Transformers and no Labels
papers.review: LOST uses DINO patch-key relations for object discovery and class-agnostic detector training. External self-supervised features for object localization are established. Candidate58's CLS binary readout is not LOST replication or a novelty claim.
